notes: Start 6 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build a @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@as a drop off point (similar to a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@)

Get @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ and @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@ if needed. Raid opponent alot and play game out to get castle and lancers. See video for more tips.

name: Top Secret Matsuri on gold start
author: ToTheMoon321

notes: Send 2 to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and 3 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. One Vill builds @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on Gold. @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@

Once vills mine 30 gold, pull and help finish @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@. Once finished, use 130 gold to buy wood and queue first@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@. Send Matsuri vills to food after for one dropoff. Then back to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Continue @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@. Once 130 gold, buy another 100 wood at @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ and queue second@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@.
After first @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ finished, send wood vills to @resource/sheep.webp@
Build @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on gold (and wood if possible). @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@
Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@to build @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@. If expecting to be rushed, build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Age up with @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ (will save wood for FC all in).
2 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 3 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 1 builds @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, rally to @resource/sheep.webp@
Once you have 75@resource/resource_wood.webp@, send the 2 vills to@resource/resource_gold.webp@

Leave 1 vill on @resource/berrybush.webp@ to build @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ and put 8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, rally on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, get @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@

@landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@ completes, the vills go to @resource/sheep.webp@, once you have 11 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, rally to @resource/sheep.webp@. Make @building_military/stable.webp@+@building_military/archery-range.webp@ for @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@+@unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@, get all the eco+forge techs, build horse estate if you play against knight civs, and archer estate if you dont and win the damn game

Split @abilities/repair.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ into 2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, Bring out @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Just keep a 4 to 1 ratio of
Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@ in @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ (for 130 gold) and make 2nd @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ on  @resource/boar.webp@/@resource/deer.webp@
Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@ in @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ (For 135 Gold) and make 3rd  @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@and @resource/berrybush.webp@

Build @building_military/stable.webp@@technology_sengoku/takeda_daimyo_1.webp@ ->@building_military/stable.webp@ (Move off wood unless need @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ or @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@)

@resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and start making @building_economy/farm.webp@ around @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@with the extra @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@and research @technology_sengoku/yatai_farm_gathering.webp@
Put some on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ so try to get 2nd @building_military/stable.webp@@technology_sengoku/takeda_daimyo_3.webp@/@building_economy/town-center.webp@ if need 2
@resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and start making @building_economy/farm.webp@ until 30 on food
5 Villager gather 1 Tree then Berries - 1 Villager builds House at Berries
1 Villager to Sheep 1 Villager to Berries (Wood Villagers move to Berries automatically)
1 Villager to Gold then Villagers to Sheep until 13
Build Landmark Ryokan with all Sheep Villagers
Buy wood when @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ is finished and build 1 @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@
When 50w in bank pull 2 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. (straggler has 50/150)
@resource/rally.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and take the last sheep vill to wood as well
Build @building_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ for either ranged or cav depending

2nd @building_military/archery-range.webp@ & get important upgrades @technology_sengoku/higoyumi.webp@ and blacksmith upgrades by building @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@
Can buy 100 stone now and build 2nd stable @building_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ if feudal v feudal game.
